content:
I can’t determine the most likely next items from a single purchased item ID alone. That requires transaction co-occurrence or product-association data for item 16012.

If you provide the purchase history or association rules, I can rank the top 10 item IDs.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 16012. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
